title: Build sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 native libraries with Qualcomm NPU (QNN) and diarization, and package them
description: The app's speech engine is sherpa-onnx (PRD Scope). The published Android AAR has no NPU support, and sherpa's prebuilt NPU APK libraries lack speaker diarization, so we compile `libsherpa-onnx-jni.so` from the v1.13.8 source with QNN **and** diarization enabled, add Qualcomm's QNN runtime libraries, and take the Kotlin API classes from the official AAR. Serves goals 1 and 2.
steps: Create executable `scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh` (bash, `set -euo pipefail`, `cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."`, `source scripts/env.sh`). Constants: `VERSION=1.13.8`, `WORK=$HOME/.local/share/convoscribe-toolchain/sherpa-onnx-build`, `OUT=app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a`, `JAR=app/libs/sherpa-onnx-classes-$VERSION.jar`. If `$OUT/libsherpa-onnx-jni.so`, `$OUT/libQnnHtp.so` and `$JAR` all exist and `--force` was not passed, print `sherpa-onnx native libs OK` and exit 0.
Source: if `$WORK/sherpa-onnx` is missing, `git clone --depth 1 --branch v$VERSION https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx "$WORK/sherpa-onnx"`.

QNN headers: if `$WORK/qnn-include-2.40.0.251030/include/QNN/QnnInterface.h` is missing, download `https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models-qnn/qnn-include-2.40.0.251030.tar.bz2` into `$WORK` and extract with `tar -xjf`. QNN runtime libs: likewise `https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models-qnn/qnn-libs-2.40.0.251030.tar.bz2` → `$WORK/qnn-libs-2.40.0.251030/` (contains libQnnHtp.so, libQnnHtpPrepare.so, libQnnSystem.so and libQnnHtpV{68,69,73,75,79,81}{Skel,Stub}.so).

Build (this mirrors sherpa's own `scripts/apk/build-apk-qnn-asr.sh.in`, but with diarization ON): in `$WORK/sherpa-onnx` run `env QNN_SDK_ROOT=$WORK/qnn-include-2.40.0.251030 ANDROID_NDK=$ANDROID_NDK SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_QNN=ON SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_SPEAKER_DIARIZATION=ON SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_TTS=OFF SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_BINARY=OFF SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_C_API=OFF SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_JNI=ON BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON ./build-android-arm64-v8a.sh` (it downloads a prebuilt onnxruntime itself; the build takes 10–30 minutes, run it in the foreground with a timeout of at least 45 minutes and do not end the session while it runs).

Copy: `mkdir -p $OUT && rm -f $OUT/*.so`, then `cp $WORK/sherpa-onnx/build-android-arm64-v8a/install/lib/*.so $OUT/` and `cp $WORK/qnn-libs-2.40.0.251030/*.so $OUT/`. Verify: `$OUT/libsherpa-onnx-jni.so` and `$OUT/libonnxruntime.so` exist, and `strings $OUT/libsherpa-onnx-jni.so | grep -q Java_com_k2fsa_sherpa_onnx_OfflineSpeakerDiarization` and `... | grep -q prependAdspLibraryPath` both succeed (exit 1 with a clear message otherwise).

Kotlin classes: download `https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/v$VERSION/sherpa-onnx-$VERSION.aar` to `$WORK`, check `sha256sum` equals `633c24321e06b1fe79feafa03ea16cbc0f8a286641e2da3559bac91bdb13bd96` (exit 1 on mismatch), then `unzip -p <aar> classes.jar > $JAR`. Do NOT use the AAR itself as a dependency: its bundled native libs (no NPU) would clash with ours.
`.gitignore`: add `app/src/main/jniLibs/` and `app/libs/*.jar` (built artifacts, ~200 MB, never committed).

`app/build.gradle.kts`: `val sherpaJar = file("libs/sherpa-onnx-classes-1.13.8.jar")`; `check(sherpaJar.exists() && file("src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a/libsherpa-onnx-jni.so").exists()) { "Missing sherpa-onnx native build - run bash scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh" }`; `implementation(files(sherpaJar))`. In `defaultConfig` set `ndk { abiFilters += listOf("arm64-v8a") }`. Add `packaging { jniLibs { useLegacyPackaging = true } }` — REQUIRED: the Hexagon DSP loads `libQnnHtpV*Skel.so` from the app's extracted native library directory, which is empty without legacy packaging.

`AndroidManifest.xml`, inside `<application>`: `<uses-native-library android:name="libcdsprpc.so" android:required="false" />` with an XML comment: required so the QNN HTP backend can reach the DSP; without it device creation fails with error 14001.
Create `app/proguard-rules.pro` with `-keep class com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.** { *; }` and reference it from the release build type (minify stays disabled).

Create `engine/sherpa/SherpaInfo.kt`: `object SherpaInfo { const val VERSION = "1.13.8"; fun defaultFeatureConfig() = com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.FeatureConfig(sampleRate = 16000, featureDim = 80) }` (proves the classes compile).

Add a section 'Native engine (sherpa-onnx + Qualcomm QNN)' to `README.md`: what the script does, that it takes 10–30 min, `--force` to rebuild, and that the QNN libraries are Qualcomm AI Engine Direct runtime files redistributed by sherpa-onnx.
Run `bash scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh`, then the verify command.
acceptanceCriteria: `bash scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh` exits 0; a second run prints `sherpa-onnx native libs OK` immediately
`app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a/` contains libsherpa-onnx-jni.so, libonnxruntime.so, libQnnHtp.so, libQnnSystem.so, libQnnHtpPrepare.so and libQnnHtpV73Skel.so
`unzip -l app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk | grep 'lib/arm64-v8a/libQnnHtpV73Skel.so'` matches and there is no `lib/x86_64/` or `lib/armeabi-v7a/` entry
The manifest contains `uses-native-library` for `libcdsprpc.so` and `app/build.gradle.kts` sets `useLegacyPackaging = true`
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: If the CMake build fails, read the first error in the output; common causes: `ANDROID_NDK` unset (source scripts/env.sh), `QNN_SDK_ROOT` not pointing at the directory containing `include/QNN/QnnInterface.h`, or no network for the onnxruntime download (that is BLOCKED). Do not change sherpa-onnx source code. | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` engine classes (OnlineRecognizer, OnlineStream, OfflineSpeakerDiarization, SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor, ...) in unit tests; plain `*Config` data classes are fine. Only reference sherpa classes inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
